$comment: M68: versioned content contract for data/<namespace>/dungeon_adventure/*.json. One file per theme, named for that theme's own id, describing which themes a run can transition into from here. Identity is the resource id namespace + the relative path with the .json suffix stripped, and that id MUST match a loaded dungeon_theme id (a node whose id has no theme is a dead end and is dropped with a rejection). The parser is AdventureGraphs.parseNode. A transition's 'theme' is a theme id with the same legacy resolution rules as a dungeon_room 'theme' entry: a qualified id resolves directly, a legacy unqualified id resolves to pocketdungeons:<name> when that built in exists, otherwise it is an unresolved legacy reference and the transition is dropped with a rejection rather than silently last file wins.

version.$comment: Content contract version this file declares. 1 is the only generation this round ships.

next.$comment: Weighted transitions out of this node. A boss node must declare none; an entry or descent node must declare at least one. Every transition target must resolve to a loaded theme that itself has an adventure node, or the transition is dropped (and the node with it, transitively, until a fixpoint).

reward.$comment: The Herobrine Cube power id a rare drop from this node's encounters grants, or omitted for a node with no extractable reward. A blank but present value is rejected.

theme.$comment: Target theme id. Qualified (mypack:deepslate) or legacy unqualified (deepslate, resolving to pocketdungeons:deepslate).
